## Appearance

He is a tall, frank-faced fellow with broad shoulders, curly brown hair, and roguish, clear hazel eyes. His mouth often features a teasing smile, though he has also been described as appearing pale and rather thin.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Weddings P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022)_

## Personality

Gilbert is a clever, good-natured, and thoughtful young man known for his teasing demeanor and keen sense of humor. Full of zest and ambition, he is determined to earn his own way through college in order to fulfill his goal of becoming a doctor.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## History

Gilbert Blythe spent three years in Alberta caring for his sick father and a summer visiting cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick) before returning home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Upon returning to school, he inadvertently sparked a fierce, years-long academic rivalry with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after mockingly calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her braid, prompting her to smash a slate over his head and refuse his apology. Though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) maintained a bitter front, Gilbert repeatedly attempted to make amends, even rescueing her when her boat sank. The two continued to compete intensely through their studies in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Gilbert earned the graduation medal. Demonstrating his underlying kindness, he surrendered his appointment as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could remain near [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), an act that finally prompted her to forgive him and become his close friend. Alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Gilbert co-founded the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and after two years of teaching, both moved on to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). There, he led the freshman class to victory in the annual Arts Rush. During their second year, Gilbert proposed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in an orchard, but she rejected him, fracturing their close friendship and leaving him heartbroken. Over time, he began spending time with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), which secretly disquieted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), though he eventually accompanied [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home following Diana's wedding. Shortly after, Gilbert contracted a severe case of typhoid fever, passing a critical night before recovering. Upon his recovery, he took [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a walk to [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden, where he proposed once again; this time, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) happily accepted, and the two looked forward to a future together.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), +51 more_

## Quotes

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)

> “Not she,” said Gilbert emphatically. “I know Louisa Spencer well. She doesn’t ‘believe’ in Village Improvement Societies, but she does believe in dollars and cents. She’d be more likely to urge Judson on than to dissuade him.”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P46](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0046)

> "It’s a nice old burg, they tell me, and has the finest natural park in the world. I’ve heard that the scenery in it is magnificent."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Change P22](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0022)

> "You’re just tired, Anne. Come, forget it all and take a walk with me—a ramble back through the woods beyond the marsh. There should be something there I want to show you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Autumn P15](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0015)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began as bitter childhood rivals after Gilbert teased her, though he eventually saved her from a leaking boat and tried to offer an apology that she initially refused. Over time, their dynamic softened into a close friendship and literary collaboration as they wrote newspaper notes together. Despite their bond, Gilbert harbors unrequited romantic feelings for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), which led to tension and heartbreak when she rejected his marriage proposal.
